about_hero_description: Chillspace is a social network designed for conversations that feel good—simple, human, and free from the noise.
about_values_title: Digital spaces can make room for what matters, too.
about_value_one_text: Here, we take the time to reply, laugh, and share what feels like us.
about_value_two_text: No race for visibility. Just people, ideas, and real connections.
about_value_three_title: A space that belongs to you
about_value_three_text: You choose what to share, with whom, and how much room digital life takes up.
about_conversation_statement: Because a good conversation can change an entire day.
about_story_one: We created Chillspace around a simple idea: social networks should bring us closer to what makes us feel good, not wear us down.
about_story_two: So we are building a calm place to share a thought, reconnect with loved ones, and discover new voices—at your own pace.
about_care: Made with care, for real people.
about_cta_title: Your next great conversation may start here.
privacy_intro: This policy explains, in plain language, what information Goodspace uses and how we use it.
privacy_collect_text: We collect the information you provide when you create and use your account, such as your name and email address. We also store the content and interactions you choose to share on Goodspace, along with basic technical information needed to keep the service secure and reliable.
privacy_use_text: We use this information to provide Goodspace, keep your account secure, help people connect, respond to requests, and improve the product. We do not sell your personal information.
privacy_share_text: Your public profile and content are visible to people who can access them in Goodspace. We may share limited information with trusted providers that help us operate the service, or when the law requires it.
privacy_choices_text: You can review and update the information in your account. You can also choose what you share publicly. If you have a privacy question, please contact the Goodspace team.
privacy_updates_text: If this policy changes, we will publish the updated version on this page. Continuing to use Goodspace after an update means you accept the revised policy.
terms_intro: These terms describe the simple rules for using Goodspace.
terms_using_text: By creating an account or using Goodspace, you agree to follow these terms and our privacy policy. You must provide accurate information and keep your account secure.
terms_content_text: You keep ownership of the content you post. By posting it, you give Goodspace permission to display and share it as needed to operate the service. Only share content you have the right to share.
terms_respect_text: Do not use Goodspace to break the law, harm others, impersonate people, distribute harmful software, or abuse the service. We may remove content or restrict accounts that violate these rules.
terms_changes_text: We work to keep Goodspace available and useful, but features may change or be temporarily unavailable. We may suspend or end access when necessary to protect the service or its community.
terms_updates_text: When these terms change, we will publish the new version on this page. By continuing to use Goodspace, you accept the updated terms.
